title: A1
query: What is the functional domain associated with EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName AS FunctionalDomain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:PART_OF]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: A2
query: What are the amino acid changes and mutation descriptions for EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) RETURN m.hasWildTypeResidue AS WildTypeResidue, m.hasMutationDescription AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {name: 'EGFR'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) RETURN m.hasMutationId,         m.hasWildTypeResidue + '>' + m.hasMutantType AS aminoAcidChange,         m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "EGFR"})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) RETURN m.aminoAcidChange, m.mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:has_other_mutation]->(m:OtherMutation) RETURN m.hasMutationAA AS Amino_Acid_Changes, m.hasMutationDescription AS Mutation_Descriptions LIMIT 100

title: A3
query: In which organisms is DCLK1 protein present?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK1'})-[:PRESENT_IN]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.hasScientificName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK1'})-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "DCLK1"})-[:hasOrganism]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.hasScientificName LIMIT 100

title: A4
query: What pathways does EGFR protein participate in?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[r:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(w:Pathway)  RETURN w.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(path:Pathway) RETURN path.hasPrimaryName AS PathwayName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(path:Pathway) RETURN path.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: A5
query: What reactions are produced by the 'RHOJ GTPase cycle' pathway?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Pathway {hasPrimaryName: 'RHOJ GTPase cycle'})-[:produces]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Pathway {hasPrimaryName: 'RHOJ GTPase cycle'})-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.hasPrimaryName AS ReactionName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Pathway {hasPrimaryName: 'RHOJ GTPase cycle'})-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Pathway {hasPrimaryName: 'RHOJ GTPase cycle'})-[:participatesIn]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.hasPrimaryName AS ReactionName LIMIT 100

title: A6
query: List all proteins belonging to the EGFR family.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (:EGFRfamily)-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (family:Family {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:ENCODEDIN]->(protein:Protein) RETURN protein.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein) RETURN DISTINCT p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName LIMIT 100;

ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'}) RETURN p.hasTissueSpecificity LIMIT 100

query: What is the chromosomal position of the EGFR protein?

ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:PRESENTIN]->(c:CellularLocation) RETURN c.hasPrimaryName AS CellularLocation LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'}) RETURN p.hasCellularLocation LIMIT 100

title: B1
query: What are the sequence motifs found in the amino acid sequence of the EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasUniprotSynonymName: 'EGFR'})-[:LOCATEDIN]->(sm:SequenceMotif) RETURN sm.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:LOCATEDIN]->(s:SequenceMotif) RETURN s.hasPrimaryName AS SequenceMotif LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain)-[:hasSequenceMotif]->(sm:StructuralMotif) RETURN sm.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: B2
query: Which sample is associated with the gene expression of EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (g:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein {hasProteinName: 'EGFR'}) -[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) RETURN s.hasSampleName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (s:Sample)-[:INSAMPLE]->(g:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein {name: 'EGFR'}) RETURN s.hasIdSample AS SampleID, s.hasSampleName AS SampleName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) RETURN s.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (g:Gene {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[r:expressed_in]->(s:Sample) RETURN s.hasIdSample LIMIT 100

title: B3
query: What are functional domains in the EGFR protein that belong to Human?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HAS_FUNCTIONAL_DOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE (p)-[:PRESENT_IN]->(o:Organism {hasPrimaryName: 'Human'}) RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName, fd.uri LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' WITH fd MATCH (fd)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE o.hasScientificName = 'Homo sapiens' RETURN fd.name AS FunctionalDomain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:PART_OF]->(f:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT f.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: B4
query: Which samples with primary site 'skin' have missense mutations in the protein 'DCLK3'? Please provide the sample names.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (s:Sample {hasPrimarySite: 'skin'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) WHERE EXISTS ((p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'})-[:OCCURS_IN_Mutation]->(m)) RETURN s.hasSampleName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) WHERE s.primarySite = 'skin' RETURN DISTINCT s.name LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (s:Sample {hasPrimarySite: 'skin'})-[:MISSENSE]->(m:Missense)-[:PROTEIN]->(p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'}) RETURN s.hasSampleName AS SampleName LIMIT 100

title: B5
query: List all organisms that are classified under the 'Plant' clade.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (o:Organism)-[:ISPARTOF]->(c:IsClade) WHERE c.hasPrimaryName = 'Plant' RETURN o.hasPrimaryName, o.hasScientificName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (organism:Organism)-[:ISPARTOF]->(clade:Clade {hasPrimaryName: 'Plant'}) RETURN organism.hasPrimaryName AS PrimaryName, organism.hasScientificName AS ScientificName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (o:Organism)-[:ISPARTOF]->(c:Clade {hasPrimaryName: 'Plant'}) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (o:Organism)-[:IS_A]->(c:Clade {hasPrimaryName: 'Plant'}) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: B6
query: Which proteins have functional domains named 'Pkinase'?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'Pkinase' RETURN p.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'Pkinase'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.hasFullName AS ProteinName, fd.hasPrimaryName AS FunctionalDomainName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'Pkinase'}) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r]-(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'Pkinase' RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName LIMIT 100

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HAS_SEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) RETURN s.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:ASSOCIATEDWITH]->(s:Sequence) RETURN s.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasUniprotPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:has_sequence]->(s:Sequence) RETURN s.hasPrimaryName AS SequenceName LIMIT 100

query: List the names of samples implicated in cancer type 'glioma_gliosarcoma'.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (s:Sample)-[r:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer {hasPrimaryName: 'glioma_gliosarcoma'}) RETURN s.hasSampleName LIMIT 100

ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (c:Cancer {hasPrimaryName: 'glioma_gliosarcoma'})-[:implicated_in]->(s:Sample) RETURN s.hasIdSample, s.hasSampleName LIMIT 100

title: B9
query: Which proteins have mutations of type 'Missense'?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) WHERE m.hasMutantType = 'Missense' RETURN p.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName, m.hasMutationId AS MutationID, m.hasWildTypeResidue AS WildTypeResidue, m.hasMutantType AS MutantType, m.hasStartLocation AS StartLocation, m.hasEndLocation AS EndLocation
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r]-(m:Missense) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName, m.hasMutationDescription AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100

title: B10
query: List the proteins with cellular location 'Cytoskeleton' that are found in the organism 'Mouse'.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasCellularLocation: 'Cytoskeleton'})-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism {hasPrimaryName: 'Mouse'}) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE p.hasCellularLocation = 'Cytoskeleton' AND o.hasPrimaryName = 'Mouse' RETURN DISTINCT p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism {hasPrimaryName: 'Mouse'}) WHERE p.cellularLocation = 'Cytoskeleton' RETURN p.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasCellularLocation: 'Cytoskeleton'}) MATCH (o:Organism {hasPrimaryName: 'Mouse'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName LIMIT 100

title: C1
query: What ligands interact with the sequence motifs of the IRAK1 protein, and what is the type of interaction?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (protein:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'IRAK1'})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(motif:SequenceMotif)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(ligand:Ligand) RETURN ligand.hasPrimaryName AS LigandName, motif.hasPrimaryName AS MotifName, ligand.isDrug AS IsDrug LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (seqMotif:SequenceMotif)-[:HASMOTIF]->(ligInt:LigandInteraction),       (ligInt)-[:HASLIGAND]->(lig:Ligand) WHERE seqMotif.hasPrimaryName IN ['IRAK1 sequence motif'] RETURN lig.hasPrimaryName AS LigandName, lig.isDrug AS IsDrug, ligInt.hasType AS InteractionType
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'IRAK1'})-[:HAS_FUNCTIONAL_MOTIF]->(m:Motif)-[r:INTERACTS_WITH]->(l:Ligand) RETURN l.hasPrimaryName AS Ligand, type(r) AS InteractionType LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'IRAK1'})-[:HAS_SEQUENCE]->(s)-[:HAS_MOTIF]->(m) MATCH (m)<-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(l:LigandActivity) RETURN l.hasPrimaryName AS Ligand, l.uri AS InteractionType LIMIT 100

title: C2
query: List the cancer types linked to mutations found in the DCLK3 protein.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense)-[:ASSOCIATEDWITH]->(c:Cancer) RETURN c.hasPrimaryName  LIMIT 100;
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) RETURN DISTINCT c.hasPrimaryName AS CancerType
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'})-[r:HASMUTATION]->(m:Mutation) MATCH (c:Cancer)-[:ASSOCIATEDWITH]->(p) RETURN distinct c.hasPrimaryName as CancerType LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'})-[:IN_COMPLEX|:PART_OF|:COMPLEX_SUBUNIT]->(c:Complex)-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(ca:Cancer) RETURN DISTINCT ca.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: C3
query: Which cancer samples have under expression of AKT3 protein? Show sample name, regulation, and cancer type.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (s:Sample)-[:HASMUTATION]->(p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'AKT3' AND (g:GeneExpression)-[:REGULATES]->(p) AND g.hasRegulation = 'under' RETURN s.hasSampleName AS SampleName, g.hasRegulation AS Regulation, s.hasHistologySubType AS CancerType LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (sample:Sample)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein {name: 'AKT3'})<-[:ASSOCIATEDWITH]-(cancer:Cancer) WHERE p.hasRegulation = 'under' RETURN sample.hasSampleName AS SampleName, p.hasRegulation AS Regulation, cancer.hasPrimaryName AS CancerType
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (s:Sample)-[r1:INSAMPLE]->(ge:GeneExpression)-(r2:HASPROTEIN)->(p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'AKT3'}) WHERE r2.regulation = 'Under-expressed' OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[r3:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) RETURN s.hasPrimaryName AS SampleName, r2.regulation AS Regulation, c.hasPrimaryName AS CancerType LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'AKT3'})-[:IS_EXPRESSED_IN]->(s:Sample) WHERE EXISTS((g:Cancer)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(s)) RETURN s.hasSampleName AS SampleName, p.hasUniprotPrimaryName AS ProteinName, s.hasHistologySubType AS CancerType LIMIT 100

title: C4
query: Which sequence motifs are found in proteins belonging to the EGFR family?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:EGFRfamily)-[:LOCATEDIN]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN m.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:EGFRfamily)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN m.hasPrimaryName, m.hasMotifSequence, m.hasStartLocation, m.hasEndLocation
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r:HASMUTATION]-(m:Mutation) WHERE p:EGFR RETURN m.hasPrimaryName, r.name LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:EGFRfamily)-[r:hasFunctionalDomain]->(f:FunctionalDomain) RETURN f.hasPrimaryName AS SequenceMotif LIMIT 100

title: C5
query: What are the histology subtypes of cancers linked to samples that have proteins with mutation ID 'COSM4166151'?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense {hasMutationId: 'COSM4166151'}) MATCH (s:Sample)-[r]-(e) WHERE type(r) IN ['INSAMPLE', 'ASSOCIATEDWITH'] RETURN DISTINCT s.hasHistologySubType LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m {mutationId: 'COSM4166151'}) MATCH (s:Sample)-[:INSAMPLE]->(mu) MATCH (c:Cancer)-[:ASSOCIATEDWITH]->(p) RETURN DISTINCT c.histologySubtype LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (c:Cancer)-[:hasSample]->(s:Sample)-[:hasProtein]->(p:Protein)-[m:MutatedInWithId]->() WHERE m.hasMutationId = 'COSM4166151' RETURN c.hasHistologySubType LIMIT 100

title: C6
query: What is the name of the organism for proteins belonging to the Plant clade?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (c:Clade {hasPrimaryName: 'Plant'})-[:ISPARTOF]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism)-[:ISPARTOF]->(c:Clade {hasPrimaryName: 'Plant'}) RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:IN_CLADE]->(c:Clade {hasPrimaryName: 'Plant'}) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName, c.hasPrimaryName AS CladeName LIMIT 100

title: C7
query: Find pathways that include proteins containing the functional domain 'PI3_PI4_kinase' and have mutations. Please provide the names of these pathways and descriptions of the mutations.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Pathway)-[r1:HAS_REACTION]->(pc:Protein)-[r2:HAS_FUNCTIONAL_DOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) WHERE exists(pc-HAS_MUTATION-(:Missense)) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS PathwayName, pc.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Pathway)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) WITH p, m MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pr:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS Pathway_Name, m.asPrimaryName AS Mutation_Description LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r1:PART_OF]->(f:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}),       (p)-[r2:HAS_MUTATION]->(m:OtherMutation) WITH f, m MATCH (pw:Pathway)-[:HAS_PART*]->(f) RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS PathwayName, m.hasMutationDescription AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100

title: C8
query: List the organisms that have proteins containing the functional domain 'Cadherin'.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (o:Organism)-[:ISPARTOF]->(p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(f:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'Cadherin'}) RETURN o.hasScientificName as Organism, p.hasPrimaryName as Protein LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (o:Organism)-[:PRESENTIN]->(p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {name: 'Cadherin'}) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName AS OrganismName, p.hasPrimaryName AS ProteinName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'Cadherin'}) MATCH (o:Organism)-[:hasProtein]->(p) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName AS OrganismName LIMIT 100

title: C9
query: Which mutations of the protein 'BRAF' associated with samples implicated in 'carcinoma_blastoma'? Please provide the mutation IDs and mutation descriptions.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) MATCH (s:Sample)-[:INSAMPLE]->(m) WHERE s.hasHistologySubType = 'carcinoma_blastoma' RETURN m.hasMutationId AS MutationID, m.hasMutationDescription AS MutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) WITH m MATCH (s:Sample)-[r:ASSOCIATEDWITH]->(c:Cancer {hasHistologySubType: 'carcinoma_blastoma'}) WHERE r IS NOT NULL AND (s)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) RETURN m.hasMutationId, m.hasMutationDescription
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) MATCH (s:Sample)-[:INSAMPLE]->(m) WHERE s.hasPrimaryName = 'carcinoma_blastoma' RETURN m.mutationID, m.mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:HAS_MUTATION]->(m:OtherMutation) WITH m, p MATCH (m)-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH_SAMPLE]->(s:Sample {hasHistologySubType: 'carcinoma_blastoma'}) RETURN m.hasMutationId AS Mutation_ID, m.hasMutationDescription AS Mutation_Description LIMIT 100

title: C10
query: What are the reactions associated with pathways in which BRAF protein participates?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(path:Pathway) WITH path MATCH (path)-[:INVOLVES|PRECEDES?*1..2]-(rxn:Reaction) RETURN rxn.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(path:Pathway)-[:HAS_REACTION]->(r:Reaction) RETURN DISTINCT r.hasPrimaryName AS ReactionName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:participates_in]->(pathway:Pathway)-[r1:involved_in]->(reaction:Reaction) RETURN DISTINCT reaction.hasPrimaryName AS ReactionName, pathway.hasPrimaryName AS PathwayName LIMIT 100;
